title: Planck's 1901 paper on the black-body spectrum
summary: Planck published the energy-distribution law that introduced energy quanta.
body: Max Planck's 1901 paper "Ueber das Gesetz der Energieverteilung im Normalspectrum" is the published form of his black-body radiation law. The v1 timeline "1900: Max Planck introduces energy quanta" points at this work (the oral report was late 1900; this journal version is 1901). The paper is about thermal radiation, not a full quantum mechanics.
